parole.testo: Unknown. Perhaps from Cantonese 煮飯／煮饭 (zyu² faan⁶) or Taishanese 煮飯 /煮饭 (zi² fan⁵). The Comisión Lexicografía de la Academia Peruana (CLAP) proposed that it is from Cantonese 食飯喇 (sik⁶ faan⁶ laa³). Compare Spanish chaufa, from Cantonese 炒飯／炒饭 (caau² faan⁶).
